description: This file defines an abstract class 'ConnectionListener' responsible for managing network connection acceptance, handling connection lifecycle, and integrating with the Orleans runtime infrastructure. It includes methods for starting/stopping listening, accepting incoming connections, creating and managing connection objects, and logging relevant events.

classes.name: ConnectionListener
classes.description: An abstract class that manages network connections, including binding to an endpoint, accepting incoming connections, running connection loops, and handling shutdown procedures.

methods.name: BindAsync
methods.description: Binds the listener to its specified endpoint and prepares it to accept connections.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initiates the accept loop to start accepting incoming connections.

methods.name: RunAcceptLoop
methods.description: Async method that continuously accepts incoming connections and starts handling them.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully stops the listener, unbinding it, closing active connections, and disposing resources.

methods.name: StartConnection
methods.description: Begins processing a new accepted connection.

methods.name: RunConnectionAsync
methods.description: Handles the lifecycle of a single connection, including running it and logging termination events.

methods.name: BeginConnectionScope
methods.description: Creates a logging scope for a connection if enabled.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Virtual method for derived classes to configure the connection builder.
